thread:
rachel: Kicking off v2024.11 staged rollout -> 10% in us-east / eu-west. Quick flag: QA reported intermittent tokenizer truncation on very long system prompts in eu-west. Can we do a stop/go?

deploy-bot: deploy 1967894321 initiated by rachel — canary -> 10%. Targets healthy 9/90. Logs streaming: `svc/tokenizer` :eyes:

miguel: Which tokenizer variant? I think token-v2 with packaging change landed. fallback default looks unset in artifact.

nina: Correct, packaging override removed the runtime default. We intended `fallback=true`.

ops-runner: Recommendation: hold at 10% and flip remote config `runtime.tokenizer.fallback=true` for selector rollout=canary. Observe 15m. If parse_error_rate doesn't drop below 0.3% then rollback to v2024.10.

rachel: Agree. Low-risk config flip preferred. Who can patch?

deploy-bot: executing: `rwctl prod config set runtime.tokenizer.fallback true --selector rollout=canary`
deploy-bot: matched 9 targets, applying config...
deploy-bot: config applied to 9/9 targets. change-id=cfg-1967894321-1 status=success

ops-runner: Monitoring dashboards. 6m in: eu-west parse_error_rate down from 0.9% -> 0.18%. p95 latency back ~baseline. Recommend bake 15m then decide.

miguel: I ran 100 synthetic long prompts against canary IPs; saw 1 transient parse error, no crashes.

doc-bot: release notes draft updated: "Notable: tokenizer runtime behavior changed; fallback flag now enabled for safety. Troubleshooting steps included." PR: `release/v2024.11-notes`

release-manager: Change window open til 20:00 UTC. Quick vote: :thumbsup: proceed to 25% after 15m bake if stable, :thumbsdown: hold/rollback.

rachel: :thumbsup: (hold until bake completes)

miguel: :thumbsup: (confirmed minimal repro)

nina: :thumbsup: (packaging fix incoming)

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (I'll keep alert hooks armed)

release-manager: Consensus to proceed after bake. I'll annotate rollout ticket and schedule ramp to 25% at 1967895221 (~15m) unless a hold is raised.

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1967894321: "fallback=true applied (cfg-1967894321-1); bake hold started by ops-runner"

rachel: Thanks team. Nina, let's land the packaging default fix after this deploy so we don't need the manual flip next time.

nina: On it — opening `fix/tokenizer-defaults` PR and adding a test.

ops-runner: If any metric regresses during the bake, call emergency:rollback and we'll pin to v2024.10.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 25% at 1967895221 (ETA ~15m).
